title: Hungary as a Sports Nation: Modern Infrastructure and Global Events
grammar: Consecutive correlatives (annyira ..., hogy...) in sporting analysis
goal: I can discuss the concept of Hungary as a 'sports nation' (sportnemzet) and modern Olympic champions (Egerszegi, Hosszú, Szilágyi).
I can synthesize consecutive degree structures and dynamic preverbs in formal sports commentary.
I can evaluate large-scale sports infrastructure (Puskás Aréna, Duna Aréna) and hosting world championships in Budapest.
